title: Earl of Kildare
html_source:
FitzGerald, Gerald, 8th Earl of Kildare, called the “Great Earl”.
Accused by the Archbishop of Cashel of burning down his cathedral, he answered: “I would not have done it if I had not been told that my Lord Archbishop was inside.” This frankness delighted King Henry VII, and we are told that when some one exclaimed, “All Ireland cannot govern this Earl,” Henry VII. rejoined, “Then let this Earl govern all Ireland.”
